story: Kofi and Hana are at a big party. They meet many people from different countries. They talk about their families and fun ideas.
title: A Big Party
setting: A bright community hall with many decorations.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: A young boy with dark skin and short hair.

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: A young girl with long black hair and a yellow shirt.

characters.name: Max
characters.look: A tall man with glasses and a blue sweater.

sentences.en: Kofi and his cousin Hana arrive together.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Hana walking together toward a large building.

sentences.en: Many people are inside the big room.
sentences.scene_prompt: A large room filled with many different people talking.

sentences.en: Everyone is very happy at the party.
sentences.zh: 聚会上的每个人都很开心。
sentences.scene_prompt: A group of happy people smiling and talking.

sentences.en: The women wear beautiful Chinese clothes.
sentences.zh: 这些女性穿着漂亮的中国衣服。
sentences.scene_prompt: Three women wearing bright red and gold Chinese silk dresses.

sentences.en: Max is a famous German person.
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, a tall man with glasses, waving to a crowd.

sentences.en: Hana has a great idea for games.
sentences.zh: Hana有一个很棒的游戏主意。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana pointing at a colorful game board with a smile.

sentences.en: We welcome you to join our group.
sentences.zh: 我们欢迎你加入我们的团体。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max opening a large door to welcome people into a room.

sentences.en: Every parent brings a child to the door.
sentences.zh: 每个家长都带着一个孩子来到门口。
sentences.scene_prompt: A parent holding a child's hand while walking through a large door.

sentences.en: Max was born in a small town.
sentences.scene_prompt: A small, quiet town with tiny houses and green trees.
